t: The Smith & Locke 132mm gate bolt delivers fast and secure closure with a spring-loaded design for reliable everyday use. Made from zinc-plated steel for strength and corrosion resistance, it performs well on gates, sheds, workshops and utility enclosures. Compact yet durable, it provides a firm hold with smooth action, ideal for locations needing quick access and frequent operation. Supplied fixings make fitting straightforward on timber or metal frames.
